new_destinations.name: Levuka
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage pages "Levuka" and "Ovalau"; UNESCO World Heritage colonial port town, Fiji's first capital. Ovalau (island) is folded into it.

spots.name: 199 Steps (Mission Hill)
spots.bio_draft: walk: about 199 steps up Mission Hill above Levuka to old Methodist mission buildings and a panorama over the offshore islands and Lekaleka Reef (Wikivoyage Levuka: walk up the 199 steps).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.

spots.name: Levuka Community Centre and Museum
spots.bio_draft: museum: restored 1878 Morris Hedstrom trading store housing a branch of the Fiji Museum, a library and the Levuka town museum; walking tours start here (Wikipedia Levuka; Wikivoyage Levuka suggests the town museum).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.

spots.name: Ovalau Peak
spots.pin_note: candidate point was the Ovalau island centroid; pin the peak/trailhead via resolve-pin.py
spots.bio_draft: viewpoint: hike to the mountain peak above Levuka, overlooking the reefs and the Koro Sea (Wikivoyage Levuka 'See' lists the hike). Coordinates unresolved: no OSM natural=peak found; the Ovalau article point is the island centre, not the peak.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.

spots.name: Lovoni
spots.bio_draft: village: traditional village in the fertile crater of Ovalau, reached by guided tour on foot and by truck; visitors take a village tour and lunch (Wikivoyage Ovalau, Levuka).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.

spots.name: Leleuvia
spots.bio_draft: island: coral cay about 45 minutes by boat from Levuka with day trips and simple overnight bures (Wikivoyage Ovalau, Levuka).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.

spots.name: Caqalai
spots.bio_draft: island: coral island run by the Methodist Church with simple bures, white sand beaches and snorkelling; day trips from Levuka (Wikivoyage Levuka).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Levuka and reached from that base.
